sn8.8:5.2: The idea of the seven seers, long proverbial in Vedic culture, was adapted for Gotama in [dn14](), where he is the seventh recorded Buddha in the lineage starting with Vipassī. Various texts and commentaries also allow the sense, “best of seers”.
sn8.8:5.4: In a cold northern climate this sounds unappealing, but in the heat, the generous rain is a cool blessing.
sn8.8:8.1: The “wrong path” (_ummagga_) is one that takes you to the wrong destination ([mn107:14.26]()).
sn8.8:8.3: Here Vaṅgīsa turns to address the monks directly.
sn8.8:8.4: For _asitaṁ bhāgaso pavibhajaṁ_, compare the similar phrase _vibhatto bhāgaso mito_, which refers to the neatly ordered sections of hell ([mn130:16.4]()) or the suburbs ([snp2.7:23.2]()). Vaṅgīsa is referring to the Buddha’s skill in breaking down complex or obscure matters and presenting them systematically.
sn8.8:10.2: _Ṭhiti_ is _viññāṇaṭṭhiti_ (“planes of consciousness”), i.e. realms in which consciousness can be reborn.
